summary: The charge-tail background, estimated in reco rigidity bins, is subtracted from the unfolded (truth-bin) helium counts instead of from the reco counts before unfolding, so the background is never migrated consistently.
code_change: analyse(): the unfolding input is n (not n - bkg) and bkg is subtracted from u after unfold().
description_change: recipe.json: step 'background' moved after 'unfold'; spec background estimator text now says B_k is subtracted from the unfolded helium counts.
